caption: The drawing depicts a single object resembling a decorative vase or trumpet-shaped vessel. The base and the tall, fluted stem of the object are colored yellow with subtle shading to suggest a glassy, translucent material. The base is round and features a ribbed pattern, while the stem rises vertically from the center. The top of the vessel flares out widely into a ruffled, petal-like opening that is colored pink with light reflections and darker accents for depth. The background is an even, light beige color with slight texture, and there are no additional objects or distinct background elements present in the image. The artist's signature, "Stewart," appears at the lower right corner of the image.
title: Vase
